_about: One release entry in the release format, written by scripts/release-runs.py from real runs of two builds. The commands, output lines, exit codes, result files and builds come from the raw record in site/changelog/logs/; whole lines are cut to fit by the fixture, no line is edited. Only label, headline, lead, next.note and film are written by hand. Whether the release is tagged, and its date, come from git when the site is built.
label: Report change
headline: stash no longer calls a folder clear when an item stayed behind

lead.text: When an item in the folder cannot be read, stash 0.5.4 moves the rest, says the folder is NOT clear and exits with code 3. Version 0.5.3 moved the same 4 files, left the same unreadable folder behind, still said the folder was clear and exited with code 0. In
, not at the top level; the 0.5.3 JSON has no clear key at all.

output: No deadline. Restore with: stash pop
1 item could not be read and stays in place. The selected folder is NOT clear.

note.text: No override flag. To put the 4 files back, run

runs_note: Each ran the same commands on a fresh copy of one synthetic folder, notes: 4 small text files, 2 of them carrying the Finder tag Keep, and a subfolder, private, that cannot be read. Output is shortened to fit by cutting whole lines. Every command ran in a sandbox that let it write only inside its scratch folder and could not run /usr/bin/security.
